title: Anaphylaxis: Epinephrine First, and What the PCP Adds

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already recognize anaphylaxis and give IM epinephrine. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Understand why anaphylaxis drops the BP and closes the airway
  2. Spot the danger signs: stridor, silent chest, falling LOC
  3. Know what the PCP adds: IV fluid, salbutamol, diphenhydramine

Textbook: Chapter 33, PDF pages 2946–2976
slides.say: Welcome to class. As EMRs, you already know the most important part of this topic: recognize anaphylaxis and give epinephrine into the muscle, fast. That doesn't change. Now that you're practising as a PCP, you're expected to understand why the patient is crashing, to read the airway and breathing more carefully, and to use three new tools from BC's Anaphylaxis protocol: IV fluids, salbutamol after the epinephrine, and diphenhydramine. Each comes with rules and pitfalls. Today we'll cover the physiology, the danger signs, and exactly what the PCP adds, including where the book and BC disagree.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来上课。作为 EMR，你们已经掌握了这个主题最重要的部分：识别严重过敏反应，迅速肌注肾上腺素。这一点不变。现在以 PCP 身份执业，你要理解病人为什么会垮下来，更细致地判读气道和呼吸，并使用 BC 严重过敏反应流程里的三样新工具：静脉补液、肾上腺素之后的沙丁胺醇，以及苯海拉明。每一样都有规则和陷阱。今天讲生理机制、危险征象，以及 PCP 具体多做什么，包括书和 BC 不一致的地方。

slides.title: An immune system that overreacts
slides.body:
First exposure: sensitized→IgE coats mast cells→Next exposure: histamine floods out
  • Type I hypersensitivity: fast and IgE-driven
  • Mast cells sit in the skin and around blood vessels
  • Not too little protection: too much
  • A first exposure may cause nothing; a later one can kill
slides.say: Anaphylaxis is a fast, life-threatening allergic reaction, and it starts with an earlier exposure. The first time the body meets an allergen, such as peanut protein or bee venom, it becomes sensitized and makes an antibody called IgE, which attaches to mast cells. Mast cells sit in the skin and around blood vessels, like loaded alarm boxes. Next time, the allergen sets them all off, releasing histamine and other chemicals at once. This is a Type One hypersensitivity reaction. So anaphylaxis isn't a weak immune system; it's one that overreacts. That's why a first exposure may cause nothing, and a later one can kill.
slides.sayZh: 严重过敏反应是一种来得快、可能致命的过敏反应，它始于更早的一次接触。身体第一次遇到过敏原，比如花生蛋白或蜂毒，就被“致敏”，产生一种叫 IgE 的抗体，附着在肥大细胞上。肥大细胞分布在皮肤和血管周围，像一个个上了膛的警报器。下一次，过敏原把它们全部触发，组胺和其他化学物质一下子释放出来。这叫 I 型超敏反应。所以严重过敏反应不是免疫力弱，而是免疫反应过度。这就是为什么第一次接触可能毫无反应，之后某一次却可能致命。

slides.title: What histamine does
slides.body:
Leakyfluid leaves the vesselsup to 50% of blood volume in 10 min
Widevessels dilateBP drops
Tightairways squeezewheeze, mucus
  • Lips, tongue, throat swell: angioedema
  • Hives (urticaria), flushing, itching
  • Cramps, vomiting, diarrhea
slides.say: Histamine does three big things. First, it makes vessels leaky. Fluid pours into the tissues; the book says up to half of the blood volume can shift out within ten minutes. That causes the swelling of the lips, tongue and throat, called angioedema, and leaves too little volume inside the vessels. Second, it widens the vessels, so the pressure drops further. Third, it tightens the airways and adds mucus, causing wheezing. Add hives, flushing, itching, cramps, vomiting and diarrhea. This physiology explains your treatment as a PCP: epinephrine tightens vessels and opens airways, and the fluid you give refills a leaking tank.
slides.sayZh: 组胺主要干三件大事。第一，让血管渗漏：液体涌进组织，书里说十分钟内多达一半的血容量可以转移出去。这造成唇、舌、喉的肿胀，也就是血管性水肿，血管里也因此剩下太少的容量。第二，让血管扩张，血压进一步下降。第三，让气道收紧、黏液增多，出现哮鸣。再加上荨麻疹、潮红、瘙痒、腹部绞痛、呕吐和腹泻。这些生理机制正好解释了你作为 PCP 的处置：肾上腺素收紧血管、打开气道，而你输的液体是在给一个漏水的水箱补水。

slides.title: Common triggers
slides.body:
TriggerKey points
FoodMost common prehospital cause; peanuts, tree nuts, shellfish
MedicationsPenicillins, cephalosporins, aspirin/NSAIDs; common in adults
StingsBees, wasps, fire ants; common in adults
LatexGloves, supplies; may cross-react with banana, kiwi

Injected or swallowed allergens tend to cause more severe reactions.
slides.say: What sets it off? The book says food is the most common cause on prehospital calls, especially peanuts, tree nuts and shellfish, and a tiny amount of peanut is enough. In adults, medications and insect stings are the most common causes: antibiotics like penicillin, aspirin and other anti-inflammatory pain relievers, and bee or wasp stings. Latex is another, and it can cross-react with banana or kiwi. Injected or swallowed allergens tend to cause worse reactions. Look for clues on scene: gardening suggests a sting, a seafood dinner suggests shellfish. And ask about the last few hours, because the exposure may be hours old.
slides.sayZh: 什么会诱发它？书里说院前最常见的原因是食物，尤其是花生、坚果和贝类，一点点花生就足以引发反应。成人中最常见的原因是药物和昆虫叮蜇：比如青霉素类抗生素、阿司匹林和其他消炎止痛药，以及蜜蜂或黄蜂蜇伤。乳胶也是一种，还可能与香蕉或猕猴桃交叉过敏。注射或吞下的过敏原往往引起更重的反应。在现场找线索：在园子里干活提示蜇伤，吃了海鲜大餐提示贝类。还要问过去几小时的情况，因为接触可能发生在几小时前。

slides.title: Recognizing anaphylaxis
slides.body:
• Skin or mouth signs plus breathing trouble or low BP
  • Or 2+ systems after a likely allergen (skin, breathing, BP, gut)
  • Or low BP after a known allergen: systolic < 90 or down ≥ 30%
  • The rash may have faded, or an antihistamine may hide it

BC protocol: signs of anaphylaxis + allergen exposure + unstable (syncope, decreased LOC, BP < 90, or respiratory distress)
slides.say: How do you recognize it? The book gives three ways. One: sudden skin or mouth signs, like hives or swollen lips, plus breathing trouble or low blood pressure. Two: two or more body systems involved after a likely allergen: skin, breathing, blood pressure, or the gut. Three: a drop in blood pressure after a known allergen; in adults, a systolic under ninety, or a fall of thirty percent or more from their normal. Don't rely on the rash: it may have faded, or an antihistamine may hide it. BC's protocol is written for the unstable patient: signs of anaphylaxis, an allergen exposure, and fainting, a decreased level of consciousness, a systolic under ninety, or respiratory distress.
slides.sayZh: 怎么识别？书里给了三条路径。一，突然出现皮肤或口腔症状，比如荨麻疹或嘴唇肿，同时有呼吸困难或血压低。二，接触可能的过敏原后，两个或以上系统受累：皮肤、呼吸、血压或胃肠。三，接触已知过敏原后血压下降：成人收缩压低于九十，或比本人平时下降百分之三十或更多。别只靠皮疹：它可能已经消退，或被抗组胺药掩盖。BC 的流程针对的是不稳定的病人：有过敏表现、接触过过敏原，并且出现晕厥、意识水平下降、收缩压低于九十或呼吸窘迫。

slides.title: Airway danger signs
slides.body:
You hearIt means
Stridor, hoarse voiceVoice box swelling: upper airway closing
WheezeBronchospasm: lower airways squeezing
Silent chestAlmost no air moving: worse, not better
  • Any drop in LOC: epinephrine and airway, now
  • Expect a difficult airway; prepare early
slides.say: The airway is where anaphylaxis kills fastest, so listen carefully. Stridor, a high-pitched sound when breathing in, and a hoarse voice mean the voice box is swelling: the upper airway is closing. Wheezing comes from the lower airways squeezing, which is bronchospasm. Here's the trap: if loud wheezing fades but the patient is still working hard, almost no air may be moving. A silent chest is a danger sign, not an improvement. The same goes for mental status: any drop in consciousness means epinephrine and airway management now. Swelling, mucus and tight airways can make bag-valve-mask ventilation very hard, so prepare early.
slides.sayZh: 严重过敏反应最快致命的地方是气道，所以要仔细听。喘鸣是吸气时的高调声，加上声音嘶哑，说明喉部在肿胀，上气道正在关闭。哮鸣来自下气道收紧，也就是支气管痉挛。陷阱在这里：如果响亮的哮鸣变弱，病人却仍然呼吸费力，可能几乎没有气体在流动。沉默胸是危险信号，不是好转。神志也一样：意识只要下降，就立即给肾上腺素并处理气道。肿胀、黏液和收紧的气道会让球囊面罩通气非常困难，所以要提早准备。

slides.q: After epinephrine, your patient's loud wheezes fade, but she is still working hard to breathe and is now drowsy. What does this most likely mean?
options: Very little air is moving: she is getting worse
A normal side effect of epinephrine
She is calming down and falling asleep
slides.say: Let's pause for a question. After epinephrine, your patient's loud wheezes fade, but she is still working hard to breathe and is now drowsy. What does this most likely mean? A, the bronchospasm is resolving. B, very little air is moving, and she is getting worse. C, a normal side effect of epinephrine. D, she is calming down and falling asleep. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 停一下考考你。给了肾上腺素后，病人响亮的哮鸣变弱了，但她仍然呼吸很费力，而且变得昏昏欲睡。这最可能说明什么？A 支气管痉挛正在缓解；B 几乎没有气体流动，她在恶化；C 肾上腺素的正常副作用；D 她平静下来，快睡着了。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. Quieter wheezes with continued hard breathing and a falling level of consciousness mean very little air is moving: a silent chest. Act now: repeat the epinephrine when it's due, support breathing, and prepare for a difficult airway. A is wrong because real improvement means easier breathing and a clearer mind. C is wrong because epinephrine tends to make people shaky and anxious, not drowsy. D is wrong because in anaphylaxis, a drop in consciousness means the brain is short of oxygen or blood flow.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。哮鸣变轻、呼吸仍费力、意识水平下降，说明几乎没有气体在流动，也就是沉默胸。要马上行动：到时间就重复给肾上腺素，支持呼吸，并按困难气道做准备。A 错，真正的好转是呼吸变轻松、头脑更清楚。C 错，肾上腺素通常让人发抖、紧张，而不是嗜睡。D 错，严重过敏反应中意识下降说明大脑缺氧或血流不足。

slides.title: Epinephrine: still job one
slides.body:
No absolute contraindication in anaphylaxis

BC (IM only)Dose
Adult0.5 mg IM every 5 min; may repeat up to 3 times
Child0.01 mg/kg IM, max 0.5 mg; may repeat up to 3 times
  • α1: vessels tighten · β1: stronger heart · β2: airways open
  • Onset IM 5–15 min; book: outer (anterolateral) thigh
slides.say: Epinephrine stays job one, and every licence level gives it. It's the only drug that reverses anaphylaxis: its alpha-one effect tightens the vessels, beta-one makes the heart beat faster and stronger, and beta-two opens the airways. In life-threatening anaphylaxis there's no absolute contraindication, even in older or cardiac patients, though you watch them closely. The BC adult dose is zero point five milligrams IM, into the muscle, every five minutes, and you may repeat it up to three times. For children it's zero point zero one milligrams per kilogram, up to zero point five milligrams, also up to three repeats. The book recommends the outer thigh. It takes five to fifteen minutes to work.
slides.sayZh: 肾上腺素仍然是头等大事，所有执照级别都要给。它是唯一能逆转严重过敏反应的药：α1 作用收紧血管，β1 让心跳更快更有力，β2 打开气道。在危及生命的严重过敏反应中，它没有绝对禁忌，老人和心脏病人也要给，只是要密切观察。BC 的成人剂量是零点五毫克肌注，每五分钟一次，最多可重复三次。儿童是每公斤零点零一毫克，最大零点五毫克，同样最多重复三次。书里推荐注射在大腿外侧。起效需要五到十五分钟。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the Anaphylaxis protocol
slides.body:
All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Lay supine; don't walk the patient
  • Remove the allergen (scrape stinger, stop drug)
  • Airway; oxygen to SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • Crew preps the exit; history and vital signs
  • Epinephrine IM; transport, reassess en route

PCP adds

  • IV + fluid if still hypotensive or hypoperfused
  • Bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, reassess every 500 mL
  • Salbutamol for bronchospasm after epinephrine
  • Diphenhydramine to limit the histamine response
slides.say: Here's BC's Anaphylaxis protocol. The left column is what you already do as an EMR: lay the patient flat and don't let them walk, remove the allergen, for example by scraping off a stinger or stopping a drug, manage the airway with oxygen to keep the saturation at ninety-four percent or higher, have your crew prepare the way out, take a history and vital signs, give epinephrine, and transport. The right column is new. If the patient stays hypotensive or poorly perfused, the PCP starts an IV and gives twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. The PCP also gives salbutamol for bronchospasm after epinephrine, and diphenhydramine to limit the histamine response.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的严重过敏反应流程。左栏是你作为 EMR 本来就做的：让病人平卧、不要让他走动；去除过敏原，比如刮掉蜂刺或停止给药；处理气道并给氧，使血氧维持在九十四以上；让队友准备撤离通道；采集病史和生命体征；给肾上腺素；转运。右栏是新的：如果病人持续低血压或灌注不足，PCP 建立静脉通路，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，每五百毫升复评一次。PCP 还要在肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛，并给苯海拉明来限制组胺反应。

slides.title: Diphenhydramine and salbutamol
slides.body:
DiphenhydramineSalbutamol
RoleAdd-on: blocks H1 receptorsBronchospasm after epi
BC dose25–50 mg IV or PONeb 5 mg (over 1 yr); MDI 4 × 100 mcg (adult)
Don't giveAntihistamine allergy; neonatesKnown salbutamol allergy
CautionNarrow-angle glaucoma; stenosing ulcerHeart disease; diabetes

Salbutamol is an EMR + PCP drug for asthma/COPD, but in the Anaphylaxis protocol it sits in the PCP column.
slides.say: Now the two drugs the PCP adds here. Diphenhydramine is an antihistamine. It blocks histamine at the H-one receptors, but it doesn't stop histamine being released, and it works slowly, so it's only an add-on after epinephrine. The BC dose is twenty-five to fifty milligrams IV or by mouth. Don't give it to newborns or to anyone allergic to antihistamines, and take care with narrow-angle glaucoma or a narrowing stomach ulcer. Salbutamol opens the airways. In the Anaphylaxis protocol it sits in the PCP column, for wheezing that continues after epinephrine: five milligrams by nebulizer over age one, or four puffs of one hundred micrograms by inhaler for an adult.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲这里 PCP 新增的两种药。苯海拉明是抗组胺药，在 H1 受体阻断组胺的作用，但不能阻止组胺释放，起效也慢，所以只是肾上腺素之后的辅助。BC 剂量是二十五到五十毫克静脉或口服。新生儿、对抗组胺药过敏者禁用；闭角型青光眼或狭窄性消化性溃疡要小心。沙丁胺醇用来打开气道。在严重过敏反应流程里，它列在 PCP 栏，用于肾上腺素之后仍持续的哮鸣：一岁以上雾化五毫克，或成人用定量吸入器喷四下、每下一百微克。

slides.q: Ten minutes after IM epinephrine, an adult is still wheezing, with BP 82/50. You're the PCP. Which plan matches BC's protocol?
options: Give diphenhydramine instead of more epinephrine
Repeat IM epi; IV fluid 20 mL/kg (max 2 L); salbutamol
Give epinephrine 0.1 mg by IV push
Stay on scene until the BP is above 90
slides.say: Here's a PCP decision. Ten minutes after IM epinephrine, an adult is still wheezing, with a blood pressure of eighty-two over fifty. You're the PCP. Which plan matches BC's protocol? A, give diphenhydramine instead of more epinephrine. B, repeat the IM epinephrine, start an IV with twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, and give salbutamol. C, give epinephrine zero point one milligrams by IV push. D, stay on scene until the blood pressure is above ninety. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。成人病人肌注肾上腺素十分钟后仍有哮鸣，血压八十二比五十。你是 PCP，哪个方案符合 BC 流程？A 用苯海拉明代替再给肾上腺素；B 重复肌注肾上腺素，开静脉按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，并给沙丁胺醇；C 静脉推注肾上腺素零点一毫克；D 留在现场直到血压高于九十。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. The patient is still unstable, so you repeat the IM epinephrine, which BC allows every five minutes, up to three repeats. As a PCP you start an IV for the ongoing hypotension, giving twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres and reassessing every five hundred, and you treat the remaining bronchospasm with salbutamol. A is wrong because diphenhydramine never replaces epinephrine. C is wrong because on the BC licensing exam, epinephrine is IM only. D is wrong because the protocol says transport, and keep treating en route.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。病人仍不稳定，所以重复肌注肾上腺素，BC 允许每五分钟一次、最多重复三次。作为 PCP，你针对持续低血压开静脉，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，每五百毫升复评，并用沙丁胺醇处理残留的支气管痉挛。A 错，苯海拉明永远不能替代肾上腺素；C 错，执照考试里肾上腺素只能肌注；D 错，流程要求转运，并在途中继续处理。

slides.title: It can come back: biphasic reactions
slides.body:
• Early phase: within 30 min, settles within 1 hour
  • Late phase: hours later, may last days, often worse
  • Up to 20% recur within 8 hours, even after a good response
  • Hospitals observe 4–8 hours: transport everyone

Deaths in one review: swallowed allergen within 30 min, sting within 15 min, injected drug within 5 min.
slides.say: Even when your treatment works, the patient isn't safe yet. Anaphylaxis can be biphasic, meaning it comes in two waves. The early phase starts within about thirty minutes and settles within an hour. A later phase can arrive hours afterwards, last for days, and be more severe. The book says up to twenty percent of patients have symptoms return within eight hours, even after a good response. So everyone gets transported, and hospitals usually watch these patients for four to eight hours. Speed matters at the start too: in one review, deaths came within thirty minutes of a swallowed allergen, fifteen minutes of a sting, and five minutes of an injected drug.
slides.sayZh: 即使治疗起效了，病人也还没脱离危险。严重过敏反应可以是双相的，也就是分两波来。第一波在大约三十分钟内出现、一小时内缓解；第二波可能在几小时后到来，持续几天，而且更严重。书里说多达百分之二十的病人会在八小时内复发，即使一开始反应良好。所以每个人都要送医，医院通常会观察四到八小时。开头的速度同样关键：一项回顾中，食入过敏原的死亡发生在三十分钟内，蜇伤在十五分钟内，注射药物在五分钟内。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Epinephrine: BC exam is IM only (book adds IV, infusion, nebulized)
  • Child: BC 0.01 mg/kg, max 0.5 mg (book max 0.3 mg)
  • Repeat: BC every 5 min, up to 3 times (book 5–15 min)
  • Diphenhydramine: BC IV or PO (book IM or IV)
  • Fluid: BC 20 mL/kg, max 2 L (book 1–2 L to start)
  • Glucagon: BC hypoglycemia only; no pressors or H2 blockers
slides.say: Here's where the book and the BC exam differ. The book describes IV epinephrine, infusions and nebulized epinephrine; on the exam, epinephrine is IM only. The book caps a child's IM dose at zero point three milligrams; BC uses zero point zero one milligrams per kilogram up to zero point five. The book repeats every five to fifteen minutes; BC says every five minutes, up to three repeats. The book gives diphenhydramine IM or IV; BC lists IV or by mouth. For fluids, the book starts with one to two litres; BC uses twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres. And BC lists glucagon only for low blood sugar; the book's vasopressors and H2 blockers aren't on the exam list, and the exam has no IO procedure, though BCEHS PCPs may place IOs after added-scope training.
slides.sayZh: 这里是书和 BC 执照考试不一样的地方。书里讲了静脉推注、静脉输注和雾化肾上腺素；考试里肾上腺素只能肌注。书里儿童肌注最大零点三毫克；BC 是每公斤零点零一毫克，最大零点五毫克。书里每五到十五分钟重复；BC 是每五分钟一次，最多重复三次。书里苯海拉明肌注或静脉；BC 列的是静脉或口服。补液方面，书里一开始给一到两升；BC 是每公斤二十毫升、最多两升。另外，BC 只把胰高血糖素列用于低血糖；书里的血管加压药和 H2 受体阻滞剂都不在考试药物清单上，考纲也没有开骨髓腔通路（IO）的操作规程，不过BCEHS 的 PCP 经扩展范围（Schedule 1/2）培训后可以做 IO。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Nothing delays epinephrine: not an IV, not an antihistamine
  • Fluids: reassess every 500 mL (BP, breathing, lung sounds)
  • Beta-blockers: weaker epi response, no tachycardia
  • Drowsy after diphenhydramine? Assume worsening first
  • Older or cardiac: still give epi; watch rhythm, chest pain
  • Symptoms gone? Transport anyway
slides.say: Now the new risks for you as a PCP. First, your new tools must never slow down the old one: no IV attempt or antihistamine comes before epinephrine. Second, reassess after every five hundred millilitres of fluid: pressure, breathing and lung sounds. Third, ask about beta-blockers; the book warns they can weaken the response to epinephrine and hide the fast heart rate you'd expect. Fourth, diphenhydramine can cause drowsiness, but in anaphylaxis a falling level of consciousness means poor oxygen or perfusion until proven otherwise. Fifth, older and cardiac patients still get epinephrine; watch for rhythm problems and chest pain. And if symptoms disappear, transport anyway.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲作为 PCP 的新风险。第一，新工具绝不能拖慢老工具：任何静脉穿刺或抗组胺药都不能排在肾上腺素前面。第二，每补五百毫升液体就复评：血压、呼吸和肺部听诊。第三，问有没有用 β 受体阻滞剂；书里提醒它会削弱肾上腺素的效果，并掩盖本应出现的快心率。第四，苯海拉明会让人犯困，但在严重过敏反应中，意识下降在排除之前都要当作缺氧或灌注不足。第五，老人和心脏病人照样要给肾上腺素，但要留意心律失常和胸痛。症状消失了，也照样转运。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Epinephrine IM first, every licence level: adult 0.5 mg every 5 min, up to 3 repeats
  2. PCP adds: IV fluid 20 mL/kg (max 2 L), salbutamol after epi, diphenhydramine 25–50 mg IV/PO
  3. Danger signs: stridor, silent chest, falling LOC; transport everyone

Next: Chapter 34, Gastrointestinal Emergencies
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: epinephrine IM comes first, at every licence level; for adults, zero point five milligrams every five minutes, with up to three repeats. Two: as a PCP you add an IV with twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, for persistent hypotension, salbutamol for bronchospasm after the epinephrine, and diphenhydramine, twenty-five to fifty milligrams IV or by mouth, as an add-on. Three: watch for stridor, a silent chest and a falling level of consciousness, and transport everyone, because the reaction can return hours later. Next chapter: gastrointestinal emergencies. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 记住三件事。一，所有执照级别都先肌注肾上腺素：成人零点五毫克，每五分钟一次，最多重复三次。二，作为 PCP，你针对持续低血压开静脉，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液；肾上腺素之后用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛；并用苯海拉明二十五到五十毫克静脉或口服作为辅助。三，留意喘鸣、沉默胸和意识下降；每个病人都要转运，因为几小时后可能复发。下一章讲胃肠道急症。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
